learning_outcomes.text: Distinguish and select, depending on the application, between the different digital electronics alternatives based on configurable digital circuits (PLDs and FPGAs) and microprocessor systems (microcontrollers and digital signal processors –DSP-).
Handle CAD-CAE design tools (hardware and software) for configurable digital circuits and microprocessor systems in general, and microcontrollers and DSPs in particular.
Perform software design for electronic systems based on the use of microprocessors or microcontrollers using high-level languages.
Know, select, program, and adapt to a specific application the internal modules present in microcontroller or DSP devices, with special emphasis on communication modules.
Propose and decide communications between devices using buses and alternative digital communications.

syllabus_topics: Design of basic combinational and sequential blocks.
teaching_methods: Expositive classes (PowerPoint presentations and blackboard explanations)
assessment_rules: For the ordinary call, the theory exam counts for 40% and requires a minimum of 5/10. The practical exam counts for 25% and also requires a minimum of 5/10. The proposed tasks contribute 25% and individual work 10%. For extraordinary calls and differentiated evaluation, the theory exam is 40% (min 5/10), the practical exam is 30% (min 5/10), and the proposed tasks are 30%.
